versions.changelog:
auxiliar-solve v0.1.0

- Initial release of the auxiliar-solve skill for agent task tool ranking.
- Supports ranked recommendations for OCR, PDF extraction, Brazilian NFS-e invoices, boletos, receipts, web scraping, and bookkeeping.
- Provides reproducible evals on real-world corpora, with detailed scorecards and installation instructions.
- Enables agents to discover, compare, and select tools based on accuracy, speed, cost, and compatibility.
- Offers transparent evaluation methodology, alternatives considered, and agent compatibility information.
